title: Conflict
description: A single conflict page: neutral, sourced peace-building content.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier matching the HTML file name under conflicts/, e.g. "northern-ireland".

title.description: Display title of the conflict, e.g. "Northern Ireland".

summary.description: Short, neutral overview of the conflict and its current peace-building status.

dateRange.description: Approximate active period of the conflict, if applicable.

start.description: Year or ISO date the conflict is generally considered to have started.

end.description: Year or ISO date it ended, or "ongoing".

initiatives.description: Concrete, verifiable peace-building initiatives, each attributable to an organisation and a source.

organisation.description: Name of the organisation running the initiative; should match an organisation.schema.json entry where one exists.

organisations.description: Optional list of organisation ids (see organisation.schema.json) active in this conflict.

actions.description: "What a reader can do today" — non-fundraising actions only (read, volunteer, share verified sources).

sources.description: Sources supporting the summary and initiatives.

neutralityReviewed.description: True once a contributor has confirmed the page uses neutral tone and contains no fundraising or advocacy language.
